name: 丁秀儀
objective: This course is designed to develop students' ability to critically analyze and evaluate ethical issues in contemporary business settings, with a strong emphasis on real-world case learning. Through the study of current and high-profile corporate cases (such as Boeing, H&M, Shell, Volkswagen, Starbucks, Amazon), students will learn to identify ethical dilemmas, apply key ethical principles, and use structured decision-making frameworks to propose responsible solutions. Topics include integrity, transparency, fairness, accountability, labor rights, environmental responsibility, AI ethics, and corporate social responsibility. The course encourages students to consider multiple stakeholder perspectives and reflect on moral conflicts through case-based discussions and role-play. In addition, students will be guided to use AI tools responsibly for research and idea generation while upholding academic integrity and digital ethics. By the end of the course, students will have developed a practical understanding of ethical leadership and be able to apply ethical reasoning in both professional and civic contexts.

materials: Course materials will be compiled and provided by the instructor.
consultation: Students may contact the instructor via email (hiting@ntut.edu.tw).
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks:
If needed, classes will be conducted online via Microsoft Teams. Further instructions will be provided in advance.
17 至 18 週彈性學習內容。
一、 類別
學生分組實作及討論
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查
AI 輔助學習與工具應用
二、內容
第 17 週：同儕專題交叉評論與倫理思辨
第 18 週：回饋整合、專題修正與最終成果精煉
三、時數
總共 4 小時
四、學習成果
(1) 第 17 週對其他小組專題所撰寫的評論與建議，完成同儕互評回饋單。
(2) 第 18 週繳交的最終修正版報告，繳交修正後期末專題完整報告。
五、評量比例
10%
